description:
REST Endpoint for searching for projects belonging to a given field association scheme

**[Permissions](#permissions) required:** *Administer Jira* [global permission](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/x4dKLg).

parameters.description: The starting index of the returned projects. Base index: 0.
parameters.name: startAt

parameters.description: The maximum number of projects to return per page, maximum allowed value is 100.
parameters.name: maxResults

parameters.description: The project Ids to filter by, if empty then all projects belonging to a field association scheme will be returned
parameters.name: projectId

parameters.description: The scheme id to search for associated projects
parameters.name: id

200.description: Returns a paginated list of projects associated with the field association scheme, matching the specified filter criteria.
